violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved Y splitter attached to the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH INFORMATION FOR AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. ORDER AND INSTALL. SEND EHS PHOTO VERIFICATION. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handsink in the kitchen was observed at 91f
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO RAISE THE HOT WATER AT THE HANDSINK TO 100f. PIC PLACED A WORK ORDER TICKET FOR REPAIRS. POTBELLY SANDWICH WORKS (Inspection Date: 05/19/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: in the 2DWR prep top cooler by the cash register, blue cheese was observed at 46f and mixed green salad was observed at 46f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Chicken salad, tuna salad, skinny Italian deli meats, and A Wreck deli meats in the walk-in refrigerator were observed being stored past its discard date
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 2DWR prep top cooler by the cash register was observed at 50f-52f; 2) 1DR prep top cooler on the left of the sandwich toaster was observed at 49f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE TWO COOLERS UNTIL THEY ARE REPAIRED. COOLERS FUNCTION BEST WHEN SET TO 32f-38f. PIC PLACED A WORK ORDER TICKET FOR THE COOLERS.
